instruction: Set VLC to store recordings on the Desktop, then extract audio from the music video and save it as 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp3' in the same folder.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring VLC's recording folder to Desktop and extracting audio from video to MP3 file. Evaluator uses custom function 'check_vlc_config_and_mp3_file__8f080098' to verify both: (1) VLC config has 'input-record-path=/home/user/Desktop' (30% partial credit), and (2) MP3 file 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp3' exists at /home/user/Desktop with valid content (70% partial credit). This ensures both the configuration step and the actual audio extraction outcome are verified.
